SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t1.user_id, t2.user_name, t2.kana, t2.subsidy_category_id, t1.role, t2.login_id, t1.hope_via_traning, t1.programming_experience, t4.company_name,
t3.company_id AS companyId,
t6.course_id, t6.course_name, t8.place_name, t8.place_note, t8.place_description
FROM m_lms_user t1
INNER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_company t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN m_company t4 ON t3.company_id = t4.company_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id
LEFT OUTER JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id
WHERE t1.lms_user_id = #{lmsUserId} AND t1.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg}

SELECT t1.lms_user_id, t1.user_id, t2.user_name, t4.company_name,
t3.company_id AS companyId, t6.course_id,
t6.course_name, t8.place_name
FROM m_lms_user t1
INNER JOIN m_user t2 ON t1.user_id = t2.user_id
LEFT JOIN t_user_company t3 ON t1.lms_user_id = t3.lms_user_id
LEFT JOIN m_company t4 ON t3.company_id = t4.company_id
LEFT JOIN t_course_user t5 ON t1.lms_user_id = t5.lms_user_id
LEFT JOIN m_course t6 ON t5.course_id = t6.course_id
LEFT JOIN t_user_place t7 ON t1.lms_user_id = t7.lms_user_id
LEFT JOIN m_place t8 ON t7.place_id = t8.place_id
WHERE t1.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} AND t1.role = #{role}
AND t3.company_id = #{companyId}
AND ( t6.close_time IS NULL OR t6.close_time >= #{cutoffDate} )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM t_user_place tp WHERE tp.lms_user_id = #{teacherLmsUserId} AND tp.place_id = t7.place_id AND tp.delete_flg = #{deleteFlg} )
AND t6.course_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{courseName}, '%')
AND t4.company_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{companyName}, '%')
AND t2.user_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{userName}, '%')

SELECT DISTINCT p.place_name
FROM t_user_place up
INNER JOIN m_place p ON up.place_id = p.place_id
WHERE up.lms_user_id = #{lmsUserId} AND up.delete_flg = 0
ORDER BY p.place_name
